scope: Static three-model byte identity, delta reversal, field/projection and Serde contract review only. No integrated implementation, build, runtime, hardware or legal clearance.

schema_findings.migration: Explicit breaking serialized native_l010 to native_low_power rename and Rust LseNativeL010/PeripheralLseNativeL010 to LseNativeLowPower/PeripheralLseNativeLowPower rename; no compatibility alias.
schema_findings.outer_option: Missing or explicit null native_low_power deserializes None in both input models. The serde model explicitly defaults and omits None on serialization. The generator model uses standard Option missing-field handling and is Deserialize-only. Static metadata has no serialization derives.
schema_findings.required_new_fields: Within Some, monitor_reference:String and detector_margin_lse_edges:u16 must be supplied and nonnull. No defaults or aliases were introduced. Empty/arbitrary strings and other in-range integer values are structurally representable and require generator validation.
schema_findings.factory_address: lsi_factory_trim_address:Option<u32> accepts omission or null as None in both input models; cw32-data-serde has no skip_serializing_if here, so None serializes as null inside a present profile. Some serializes as a u32 value. It is syntactically optional but semantically mandatory for factory_trim and semantically None for inherited_legal.
schema_findings.unknown_fields: Both parent configuration and native records deny unknown fields in both input models. New readers reject old native_l010 keys even when null. Stage53 readers reject native_low_power keys even when null. Old documents omitting the native profile preserve the optional None representation.
schema_findings.rust_api: Struct literal field names, imports, exhaustive patterns and new required fields require coordinated consumer migration. Static projection uses monitor_reference:&static str and retains the prior output-route static slice. Derived Debug/Hash contents may change; no source, ABI, binary or serialized-byte compatibility is claimed.
schema_findings.model_role: The project-authored serde model remains source-independent data representation. No family constants, MMIO policy or hardware validator were introduced. Widths/Option/String cannot establish family applicability, address exactness, detector margin, legal frequency, calibration, route completeness or runtime ownership.
schema_findings.old_fields: All nine prior field names, types, relative order and applicable units/meaning survive. The upper-bound comment generalizes the reference qualification; it does not authorize changing accepted L010 36080 Hz inherited-legal behavior.

baseline_semantic_evidence.migration_status: The reviewed current YAML still uses native_l010. This confirms preserved input facts, not compatibility with the new model. Integrated migration and behavior remain pending.

acceptance_conditions: Migrate both generators/emission, HAL build consumers, exact YAML and fixtures together. Do not add an alias or default that erases explicit family qualification.

Enforce exactly inherited_legal and margin 1 with trim-address None for accepted L010 parts; preserve all nine existing values/routes and 36080 Hz behavior, with prior16 profiles None and behavior unchanged.

Enforce factory_trim and margin 1 with own LSI halfword address exactly 0x001007C2 for L011/L012, bounds respectively 41000/36080 Hz, and their own exact parts/routes. Do not reuse RTC HSIOSC factory address 0x001007C0.
Use own native register TRIM widths (L011 10 bits, L012 9 bits), source-qualified runtime admission, and preserved accepted hardware restrictions; model acceptance is no proof of these.
Before claiming integrated acceptance, validate these conditions through relevant existing metadata/source tests and representative exact-part builds; no new default historical inverse checker.

Advance only the reviewed serde identity to the frozen after hash, wrapping the entire existing replacement_review as previous_review unchanged. Record both metapac before/after identities while preserving adapted ancestry, package declaration, notices, historical observed hashes and all earlier reviews.
